title: CoDuck Flags SDK — live rollout journeys

journeys.name: 01-live-rollout
journeys.promise: A running application receives a percentage rollout live, without restarting or evaluating over the network.

journeys.name: 02-sticky-exclusion
journeys.promise: A percentage rollout includes an early cohort while a holdout remains excluded.

journeys.name: 02a-unselected-cohort
journeys.promise: An account outside the percentage boundary remains on the established experience.

journeys.name: 02b-sticky-expansion
journeys.promise: Expanding a rollout admits the next cohort without removing the original cohort.

journeys.name: 03-kill-switch
journeys.promise: The kill switch overrides even a 100% rollout immediately.

journeys.name: 04-persistence
journeys.promise: A published rollout survives a full control-plane restart.

journeys.name: 05-outage-recovery
journeys.promise: An outage marks configuration stale while the last valid value remains active, then recovers.

journeys.name: 06-safety-boundaries
journeys.promise: Read credentials, malformed rulesets, and stale concurrent writers cannot corrupt the active revision.
